selection: Saved momentum holdings and sizing weights only; no rescoring or changing constituents
entry_exit: Original next-session open and close of holding session 21
rebalancing: Rebalance only at original scheduled entries; fixed share quantities within each holding period, cash not rebalanced daily
cost_timing: Same fixed round-trip basis-point charge on initial invested notional as prior diagnostics; half deducted at entry and half at final close, no netting
marking: Daily close/entry-open relative prices from original source cutoffs. Uninvested cash unchanged. Chain holding-window wealth only after reproducing original terminal returns
unresolved_position_path: For positions unresolved in the frozen original report, keep a modelled 1.0 relative value until the final mark, then apply the chosen missing-return scenario. Do not treat these modelled marks as observed prices
observed_risk: Report drawdown within each fully observed holding window, without stitching across omitted unresolved windows; whole-sample daily equity curves remain scenario estimates when any position is unresolved
scope: Both original frozen samples; prior corporate-event endpoint sensitivity is not converted into invented daily settlement paths
hypothesis: A simple reduction to 75% equal-weight exposure may offer risk reduction comparable to capped inverse-volatility weighting with simpler sizing
limitations: 75% is a round fixed research allocation, not an optimized or account-specific risk limit
Lower dollar risk must be assessed alongside lower exposure and expected return
Daily-close drawdown still misses intraday peaks and troughs
No dividends, cash interest, settlement timing or realistic variable slippage
Both samples reuse previously examined market dates; not independent temporal confirmation
Unresolved-entry and terminal-path scenarios do not establish actual portfolio drawdown
